> llms.txt — WyattAu pattern-standards canon. The authoritative design-
> pattern catalog: 149 constructs (foundations T1–T50, field P1–P92,
> frontier X1–X7), 8 refusals, 25 baseline-tier defaults, and a 27-node
> task routing graph. Consume PATTERN-CORE.md for the canon,
> references/decision-graph.md for deterministic pattern selection, and
> references/ for per-domain practice.

# pattern-standards

- [PATTERN-CORE](PATTERN-CORE.md): the canon — doctrine, baseline tier, refusals, full catalog, adoption procedure, task routing graph (§9)
- [Decision graph](references/decision-graph.md): task-type routing; 18 nodes with MANDATORY sets, ASK branches, REFUSE edges
- [Foundations: types & algebra](references/foundations-types.md): parse-don't-validate, typestate, session types, OCap, effects (T1–T10)
- [Foundations: execution & reactive](references/foundations-execution.md): structured concurrency, supervision, STM, salsa, durable coroutines (T11–T20)
- [Foundations: state & time](references/foundations-state.md): event sourcing, CRDTs, bitemporal, double-entry, e-graphs (T21–T30)
- [Foundations: distributed](references/foundations-distributed.md): sagas, outbox, fencing, DST, gossip, tail latency (T31–T42)
- [Foundations: interfaces & AI](references/foundations-interfaces.md): declarative UI, HATEOAS, Datalog, constrained decoding, sandboxes (T43–T50)
- [Field: full-stack & schema](references/field-fullstack.md): version lenses, parity gates, snapshot cursors, temporal anchors (P1–P10)
- [Field: numerical & financial](references/field-numerical.md): partition operators, units, as-of guards, ledger checksums (P11–P20)
- [Field: concurrency & reliability](references/field-concurrency.md): staleness contracts, retry budgets, criticality shedding (P21–P30)
- [Field: probabilistic & agentic](references/field-agentic.md): prompt quarantine, cascades, memoization, spend leases (P31–P40)
- [Field: security & evolution](references/field-security.md): RLS scopes, wide events, crypto-shredding, burn-rate gates (P41–P50)
- [Field: runtime operations](references/field-operations.md): circuit breaker, bulkheads, DLQs, webhook receivers, drain, trace context (P51–P54, P62–P63)
- [Field: data integrity & evolution](references/field-data-evolution.md): OCC, backfills, contract tests, strangler, ACLs, IDs, rollups (P55–P61)
- [Field: test strategy](references/field-testing.md): property tests, golden masters, mutation, fuzzing, builders, flake quarantine (P64–P69)
- [Field: API surface](references/field-api.md): tolerant reader, schema registry, error envelope, list contract, deprecation (P70–P74)
- [Field: deployment & release](references/field-deployment.md): canary, blue-green, shadow traffic, cohorts, attested artifacts (P75–P79)
- [Field: compliance & privacy](references/field-compliance.md): consent facts, DSAR pipeline, purpose tags, hash-chained audit, workload identity, rotation, break-glass (P80–P86)
- [Field: execution & trading](references/field-execution.md): order slicing, routing, fill reconciliation, TCA, data budgets, kill switch (P87–P92)
- [Frontier](references/frontier.md): epistemic types, choreography, constraint manifolds, spec-as-source (X1–X7)
